title: Column | The surprising way walking can benefit your brain - The Washington Post
summary: The article discusses the unexpected benefits of walking on brain health. It highlights how walking can positively impact cognitive function.

title: 'It was jaw-dropping': The shocking lessons from an infamous experiment in obedience - BBC
summary: A recent analysis of obedience experiments reveals that a vast majority of participants are willing to follow authority figures, with only 2.6% of 800 volunteers refusing to administer shocks in a study. This finding underscores the powerful influence of authority on human behavior, raising important ethical questions about compliance and moral responsibility.
